Xbox Is Handling the Transition From Physical Media to Digital Much Better Than PlayStation Is
Xbox just announced its plan to let players digitize their physical games for use across any number of supported devices, from PCs to handhelds to (presumably) the upcoming Project Helix next-gen PC/console hybrid. And just like that, they've made PlayStation look even worse for its tone-deaf, player-last decision to stop selling physical copies of its games starting in early 2028.
